Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api

Class Fact<T>

java.lang.Object
io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.Fact<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The object/value type of the fact.
All Implemented Interfaces:
FactReference<T>
public class Fact<T> extends Object implements FactReference<T>
A Fact is an implementation of FactReference. Facts are objects that are used by the rules engine in conditional statements. The name field of the fact is used in the conditional expression of the rule and is substituted with the object. In the following example if a fact named "variableA" is in the conditional expression of the rule and the object type is of type String then "variableA" becomes a String, and methods from the String class can be called on it. The following code would then become valid when evaluated by the rules engine: 
      variableA.equals("Imma String")
